comments.author: Bael
comments.body: Where to get or make this? There are a bunch of Tulip furniture and they make a Memorial Album but don't know if it's already implemented on Gama

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Well, back in 2007, there was a tulip boom event in Japan's server that involved getting (among other rewards) the tulip themed furniture.

gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?LiveEvent/TulipBubble

That furniture exists in a Memorial Album, which rewards a 5-shelf skill bookcase on completion.

gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?MemorialAlbum/Item3

However, on this blog post dated 2016/09/11...

uliveto.blog72.fc2.com/blog-entry-2293.html?sp

"Tumultoo ー ー ー ー, furniture of the tulip received at some event reappears as a memorial!"

And later, on 2016/10/09, from the same blog...

uliveto.blog72.fc2.com/blog-entry-2312.html

"Flowering blossoming furniture" was compiled safely - ^ - ^ No Way ↓"

Based on that, I figure the tulip furniture items existed way back in UWO's early days, but during the Age of Revolution updates, they reappeared and became MA items which can only be acquired through special events which give out the tulip furniture items. A bit like how the celeb NPC clothing has its own MA (which GAMA may never have unlocked, it seems).

That's my working theory for the moment. I haven't found anything more concrete about the tulip furniture items as yet, sorry. I'll update this if I find out anything else.

comments.author: Bael
comments.body: I did found 3 more albums related to events, there's one that the items come from a login ticket reward on JP server, I just was hoping that this furniture was craftable
